interface.signature: say_hello(name: List[str], city: str, state: str) -> str

preconditions.expression: isinstance(name, list) and all(isinstance(n, str) for n in name)
preconditions.description: The name parameter must be a list of strings.
The name list must contain at least one string.
The city parameter must be a non-empty string.
The state parameter must be a non-empty string.

postconditions.description: The output must be a formatted greeting string with the full name, city, and state.
